# stalwart_mta_stage_rcpt (Resource)

Configures RCPT TO stage processing and recipient validation. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_relaying` (Attributes) Whether to allow relaying for non-local domains (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allow_relaying))
- `max_failures` (Attributes) Maximum number of recipient errors before the session is disconnected (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--max_failures))
- `max_recipients` (Attributes) Maximum number of recipients per message (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--max_recipients))
- `rewrite` (Attributes) Expression to rewrite the recipient address (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rewrite))
- `script` (Attributes) Which Sieve script to run after the client sends a RCPT command (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--script))
- `wait_on_fail` (Attributes) Amount of time to wait after a recipient error (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wait_on_fail))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
